units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:1">Snh. VII, 1</cite> <he>ארבע מיתות … ש׳ וכ׳</he> four modes of capital punishment …, stoning, burning &c. (expl.
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 7:2">ib. 2</cite>). Ib. 52ᵃ <he>שְׂרֵיפַת נשמה</he>, v. <cite ref="N01334"><he>נְשָׁמָה</he></cite>. Ib. <he>ש׳ ממש</he> execution by fire in its real sense.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 1:3">Ab. Zar. I, 3</cite> <he>כל מיתה שיש בה ש׳ וכ׳</he> the anniversary of an idolater’s death with which burning (of garments &c.) was connected (at the time of burial) is considered an idolatrous festival.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 11:1">Num. R. s. 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="S01270"><he>קָלוֹן</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b:5">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>שקולה … כשריפת בית וכ׳</he> the death of the righteous is equal to the burning of the Temple; a. fr.—[<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:3:8">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>שריפה</he>, v. <cite ref="U01981"><he>שְׂרִיפָה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>שְׂרֵיפוֹת</he>.

<cite ref="Pesachim 75a:13">Pes. 75ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 21:9">Lev. XXI, 9</cite>) <he>תשרף לרבות כל ש׳ הבאות וכ׳</he> ‘shall be burned’, this includes all burnings which are the result of fire (e.g. death through molten lead).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 16:4">Lev. R. s. 16</cite> <he>בוא וראה כמה ש׳ הוא שורף</he> come and see how many fires it (the tongue) kindles (how much destruction it causes); a. e.
